products.name: Winter Rose Garden Christmas
products.description: A lush Christmas card bursting with blush, crimson, and deep burgundy roses, a snowy white peony, and frosted berries on a soft sage background with a lacy snowflake. products.name: Christ is Born Christmas

products.name: Joy to the World Christmas

Inside reads “Merry Christmas.”

products.name: Garden Bloom Thank You
products.description:
A cheerful thank you card with a bold floral panel of poppy red, coral, and olive blooms set among deep green leaves. A hand-cut stem rises up the center, topped with a raised flower detailed in gold, while a stitched green banner carries “Thank You” in shimmering gold. Finished with sparkling gems on a crisp cream base. Inside reads "For all the wonderful things you do."

Matching cards are available as a set.

products.name: Watercolor Thistle Thank You
products.description: A soft, artistic thank you card featuring wild magenta thistles drifting across a watercolor sky that melts from teal to golden sunlight. Framed in rich orchid cardstock with a “thank you very much” sentiment and three iridescent aqua gems that catch the light. Inside is ready for your personalized message.

products.name: Garden Bloom Thank You Set (6)
products.description: Three coordinating designs in one beautiful set, all featuring the same bold floral pattern in poppy red, coral, olive, and deep green. Includes two gatefold cards that open from the center with a “thank you” tag and dimensional blooms, three cards with diagonal strips of florals, stripes, and solid color, and one card framed in bright red with a gold “Thank You” and sparkling gems. Inside reads on all cards "For all the wonderful things you do."
